analyzed_vuln.description: `is_avrule_redundant()` indexes `type_map` using `s_idx = entry->key.source_type - 1` and `t_idx = entry->key.target_type - 1` without validating that `source_type/target_type` are in-range and nonzero. With malformed policy input, conditional AV rules can carry invalid type IDs, so `s_idx`/`t_idx` become out-of-bounds (or underflow), and the loop reads `type_map[s_idx].count` / `type_map[t_idx].count`, causing a wild read and SEGV at optimize.c:215.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer input is parsed into a kernel policy and reaches `sepol_policydb_optimize()` -> `policydb_optimize()` -> `optimize_cond_avtab()` -> `optimize_cond_av_list()`, which calls `is_avrule_redundant((*cond)->node, &p->te_avtab, type_map, 0)`. Trigger requires a malformed conditional avtab entry whose `key.source_type` or `key.target_type` is outside `[1, p->p_types.nprim]` (or 0), so subtracting 1 yields invalid indices and dereference of `type_map` out of bounds.
